news.title: Less than half of directors are independent
news.body: Following the recent departure of a director, there are only 3 independent directors on the board. The company's board is composed of: 3 independent directors. 4 non-independent directors. Independent Director Inayat Khan Khan was the last independent director to join the board, commencing their role in 2023. The company's minority of independent directors is a risk according to the Simply Wall St Risk Model.

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹2.98 (vs ₹1.83 in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹2.98 (up from ₹1.83 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹1.16b (up 148% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹101.9m (up 261% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 8.8% (up from 6.0% in 3Q 2025). The increase in margin was driven by higher revenue.
